title: Three Terms and One Short Tube
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：proportion　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 proportion 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the researcher ① judged the proportion that no student in the lab would have measured, and he said the judging was the whole of the term. The ② proportion, meaning the share itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed unmeasured in the book; a proportion, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ proportion in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ proportion at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A proportion, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the researcher said the measuring is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the proportion was the whole of the matter, meaning the balance and not the share. The ⑥ proportion, meaning the balance and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; proportion, he said, is either something you judge or the only word that means both a share and a balance. He said the balance is the part they remember.

By 1983 the ⑦ proportion had become a line in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ proportion of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in February, was one lab and three terms of measuring; proportion, he said, is either the sample at the far bench or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ proportion I remember is the share measured in the paper, which closed in 1985 and is still measured as the quietest in the lab. A ⑩ proportion, my mother said in 1987, is the only share that improves by being measured; every proportion, she said, is a balance that has agreed to look like a share. She said the balance was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 比例；部分（指实验室里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 比例；部分（指那个比例本身，与细细的试管相对）
C. 固定搭配：judge the proportion 估量这一个比例
D. n. 比例；部分（指留给孩子们测的那一份）
E. n. 比例之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的比例之事）
F. n. 比例；部分（指研究报告里写到、被测量的那一个）
G. n. 比例、均衡（指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 均衡（抽象总称，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: judged the proportion that no student in the lab would have measured
The proportion, meaning the share itself and not the tube
the proportion at the far bench
the proportion was the whole of the matter
the proportion had become a line in a paper
The proportion of the whole thing
A proportion, my mother said in 1987

answers.why: judge the proportion 意为“估量这一个比例”，1978 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位学生肯测量的一个比例做了一遍。
proportion 意为“比例；部分”，指那个比例本身而不是细细的试管，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被测量。
proportion 意为“比例；部分”，指实验室里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一支细细的试管。
proportion 意为“比例；部分”，指最远那张实验台的留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
proportion 意为“比例、均衡”，指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个均衡就是那件事的全部。
proportion 意为“均衡”，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个比例，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
proportion 意为“比例；部分”，指研究报告里写到、被测量的那一个，到 1983 年这一个成了研究报告里的一行。
proportion 意为“比例之事”，研究员二月写道，整件事的比例之事是一处实验室和三个学期的测量。
proportion 意为“比例；部分”，我记得的是研究报告里测量过的那一个，1985 年测定了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一个。
proportion 为抽象总称，母亲 1987 年说，比例是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的比例。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年那位研究员估量了实验室里没有一位学生肯测量的一个比例，他说这一遍才是那个学期的全部。（judge the proportion）
那个比例，指的是那个比例本身而不是细细的试管，经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被测量。（proportion）
那处实验室里每一个比例旁边都有同一支细细的试管。（proportion）
最远那张实验台那个比例，指的是他们留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（proportion）
叔叔说这个均衡就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那个比例。（proportion）
1987 年母亲说，比例是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的比例。（proportion）
